dimension_justifications.soundness: The core paired-certificate argument in Sec. 3 is internally coherent: simultaneous ordered-pair/group UCBs imply a bound for every simplex mixture, and the explicit outer max with zero repairs the nonnegative-regret boundary. The bundled E03 JSON arithmetically reproduces the paired MPB 0.260 rate (91/350), the Hoeffding 0.097 rate (34/350), and zero rows above tau among those committed. However, no executable implementation, split/configuration manifest, data identifiers, or environment is supplied for E03, and the other empirical result artifacts cited in the manuscript are absent. Thus the reported experimental support cannot be independently reproduced or semantically audited from this submission.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is readable, carefully scopes normal/CLT and allocation claims, labels held-out quantities as dependent diagnostics, and has a self-contained TeX/build asset set. Its evidence boundaries are nevertheless scattered across the manuscript, provenance tables, and audit records rather than consolidated in a reviewer-runnable reproducibility statement; the large appendix makes several additional numerical claims whose underlying result artifacts are not bundled.
dimension_justifications.contribution: A conditional mixture-indexed paired-regret gate is a clear, narrowly stated contribution, and the authors avoid claiming that the width surrogate optimizes the actual UCB. With the present evidence package, the empirical contribution is limited to snapshot-reported diagnostics on constructed mixtures: no end-to-end reproduction can establish the claimed experimental behavior, and no natural temporal/geographic shift result is available.

paper_summary: The paper studies a fixed candidate pool under subgroup-mixture turnover, selecting the point-estimate-best candidate at each mixture and committing only when CP or paired-difference regret upper bounds are below an operator tolerance. It proves simultaneous simplex certificates conditional on calibration and within-group invariance assumptions, reports constructed-mixture diagnostics on four classification carriers, and explicitly limits allocation analysis to a width surrogate rather than a safe allocation policy.
strongest_verified_contribution: The Sec. 3 paired-certificate construction is explicitly stated and its nonnegative repair is independently checkable from the supplied theorem and E12 audit. For supplied E03, the five-seed aggregate arithmetic supports the reported paired MPB committed rate 0.260 at tau=0.04 and zero stored committed diagnostic violations; this is artifact consistency, not an end-to-end scientific replay.
strengths: The declared snapshot hash was verified against all 23 manifest entries: all file hashes matched and the canonical root hash recomputed to a59cc79648a2b5daedc8f4b8f57637648180e5cd8d1c9eb3abffc6739eb61edc.

The supplied source, bibliography, figure, and PDF hashes agree with the round-2 build record. All active citation keys resolve in references.bib, and the build record documents deterministic fresh-copy builds; these facts are traceable, though the build was not rerun in this read-only review.

The E12 script runs read-only on the supplied E03 JSON and verifies that capping historical paired UCBs at zero changes no gates at tau in {0, 0.02, 0.04, 0.10}; this supports the stated repair boundary.

The manuscript candidly distinguishes finite-sample claims from the normal diagnostic, dependent held-out diagnostics from coverage, exploratory allocation contrasts from inferential conclusions, and missing fallback costs from utility evidence.

ethics_concerns: No direct human-subject, privacy, or safety violation is established by this snapshot. The central risk is epistemic/deployment-related: the conditional certificate does not cover within-group covariate shift or measured fallback costs, and the paper appropriately discloses these limitations. A deployed claim should remain restricted to the stated assumptions until the planned natural-shift evaluation is executed.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control, using only the frozen round-2 submission and its supplied rubric/protocol.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A manifest-complete, clean-environment replay of all numerical tables and figures, including released code, configurations, data/split identifiers, environment lock, logs, and output hashes.
